Taken at depreciation, the charge falls from 1.44% to 0.00%. Restated without one-off cash: GSK's free cash flow over 2023 to 2025 carried 1,867mm GBP of legal settlements. None recurs, so the charge stays nil. Restated to the amortisation floor: the filed cost lines leave a 21.54% pre-tax margin where the cash over 2023 to 2025 supports 23.77%, so the charge rebuilds at -2.23%. It was held at nil, but GSK books 808mm GBP of non-cash amortisation of acquired intangibles inside its cost lines in FY2025 (0001131399-26-000004), 2.47% of revenue, so the charge takes the rebuilt figure: -2.23%. Restated without working capital build: over 2023 to 2025 GSK's cash flow statement shows receivables up 1,109mm GBP, inventories up 858mm GBP, payables down 63mm GBP, a working capital build of 2,030mm GBP, 2.15% of revenue. Growth ties that cash up once, not on every product for ever, so the charge falls from -2.23% to -2.47%.
